rv.q: It truly holds up to its Olivier-winning quality expectations, and is definitely worth catching while it is in the West End this summer.
Brainiac Live is energetic, funny and genuinely impressive.
This live adaptation successfully captures that same spirit, bringing the controlled chaos and infectious enthusiasm of the television series into the theatre.

cn.t: Olivier-winning Brainiac Live delivers an explosively entertaining hour of science experiments that educates and thrills audiences of all ages with high-energy spectacle and interactive fun.
